description: NEX Location Intelligence · meaningful areas for Yogyakarta laboratory · v0.2 · adds area_kind semantic distinction (neighbourhood / corridor / belt / fallback) per project_nex_location_area_kind_semantic_doctrine_2026_08_23 · centroids and radii validated 2026-08-23.
validation_note_2026_08_23: Kaliurang low food-match count (5) confirmed as truthful — resort belt has in-house dining · not a data/geography issue. areas.name: Malioboro
areas.description: Yogyakarta city-centre shopping/tourism strip · pedestrian-heavy · high evening activity · tourist-central. Circle covers Malioboro Street from Tugu Station south to Vredeburg Fort + Beringharjo Market area.

areas.name: Prawirotaman
areas.description: South Yogyakarta backpacker + expat district · dense café + restaurant + nightlife cluster · walkable evening area.

areas.name: Kaliurang
areas.description: Merapi slopes north of Yogyakarta · villa + resort belt · nature-adjacent · cooler climate. Radius kept at 3 km after validation — low food density confirmed as truthful (resorts have in-house dining) not a geographic error.
areas.brain_phrasing_hint: in the Kaliurang belt (or 'Kaliurang mountain area')

provenance.confidence: philip-approved · low food density is truthful

areas.brain_phrasing_hint: in the Borobudur corridor / a convenient base for visiting Borobudur Temple

areas.name: Prambanan approach

areas.brain_phrasing_hint: in the Prambanan corridor / a convenient base for visiting Prambanan Temple

areas.name: Yogyakarta city
areas.description: Wider Yogyakarta urban catch-all · fallback for coords inside the city that don't match a more specific meaningful area. Precedence 99 means this is only assigned when no neighbourhood/corridor/belt matches.
